newsitem.title: USA: White House meeting, and gift, for top Republican.
newsitem.headline: White House meeting, and gift, for top Republican.

text.p: For at least a moment in the tough budget talks at the White House Wednesday President Clinton and Republican lawmakers put aside their differences to agree on one thing -- best wishes for the marriage of House Budget Committee chairman John Kasich.

The president gave Kasich a gift in celebration of his wedding Saturday to Karen Waldbillig, the Ohio Republican told Reuters. But he declined to say what it was because he had not yet told his fiancee. "I want to share it with my almost-wife before I share it with the press," he said off the House floor.

Kasich will be on his honeymoon while budget staff get down to work in an attempt to narrow differences on issues such as Medicare spending restraints and he said it never entered his mind to change his plans. "What do you think, I'm out of my mind?" he remarked.
